info.name: HustleHub+ API Tests
info.description: INSY7314 POE Part 2 API tests covering authentication, gigs, bookings, income, security and rate limits. The API uses a self signed certificate locally, so turn off certificate verification in Postman or run with Newman --insecure. The register limiter allows 5 requests per hour, so restart the API before each run (npm run test:api does this).
